  Schultz, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] add
  Recommendation #7 to the letter: Develop an Office of Violence Prevention to
  expand violence prevention and reentry services, policies, and protocols to
  reduce violence in the city to put our community on a path to success; [2] add
  Recommendation #8 to the letter: Partner with federal, state, and local
